questions.prompt: How do charms dynamically ship JSON visualization templates into Grafana within COS?
options: By writing files to /etc/grafana/dashboards/ via SSH
Using manual HTTP POST requests to Grafana's REST API
questions.explanation: The 'grafana-dashboard' relation transmits pre-packaged dashboard JSON files directly into Grafana.

questions.prompt: Which Juju command configuration key allows dynamically tuning uniter and agent logging verbosity?
questions.explanation: 'juju model-config logging-config="..."' allows granular adjustment of root, unit, and uniter log levels.

questions.prompt: Which flag allows reading the last 100 historical log entries without streaming continuously?
questions.explanation: '--replay --no-tail -n 100' outputs the last 100 log lines and exits without blocking.
